inserts `r8d` copies of the 0x130-byte element at `r9` before `rdx` into the array whose qwords `[rcx]`, `[rcx+8]`, `[rcx+0x10]` are `B`, `E`, `C`: returns when `r8d` is 0; when `r8d` is at most (`C`-`E`)/0x130 (unsigned, 32-bit) it copies `r9` to a stack local with the call at `0019E010` + 0x7C, then calls `0019E010` + 0xCC and `0019E010` + 0xDE when `r8d` is below (`E`-`rdx`)/0x130, else `0019E010` + 0x100 and `0019E010` + 0x128, advancing `E` by `r8d` elements, fills from the local with `0019E010` + 0x145, and when the local's qword `+0x100` is non-null releases it through vtable slot `+0x18` of the object at local `+0x118` (`0019E010` + 0x177); otherwise it requests max(2*size (1 when size is 0), size+`r8d`) elements times 0x130 bytes through vtable slot `+0x10` of the object at `rcx+0x18` (`0019E010` + 0x1C3), fills the block with the calls at `0019E010` + 0x1E5, + 0x1FB (`r8d` copies of `r9`) and + 0x221, calls `0019E010` + 0x230 (`rcx`, `B`, `E`), frees `B` through slot `+0x18` (`0019E010` + 0x26B) when non-null and stores the new `B`, `E` and `C`; the stack cookie from `01F44830` is checked on every path

inserts `r8d` copies of the 0x118-byte block at `r9` before `rdx` into the array whose qwords `[rcx]`, `[rcx+8]`, `[rcx+0x10]` are `B`, `E`, `C`: returns when `r8d` is 0; when `r8d` is at most (`C`-`E`)/0x118 (unsigned, 32-bit) it copies the block to a stack local and either, when `r8d` is below (`E`-`rdx`)/0x118, calls `0019E2C0` + 0x121 (`E`-`r8d`*0x118, `E`, `E`) and `0019E2C0` + 0x133 (`rdx`, `E`-`r8d`*0x118, `E`), advances `E` by `r8d` blocks and copies the local over the `r8d` blocks from `rdx`, or copies the local into each excess block from `E` (skipping a null address), calls `0019E2C0` + 0x29D (`rdx`, old `E`, advanced `E`), advances `E` again and copies the local over the blocks from `rdx` to the old `E`; otherwise it requests max(2*size (1 when size is 0), size+`r8d`) blocks times 0x118 bytes through vtable slot `+0x10` of the object at `rcx+0x18` (`0019E2C0` + 0x386), fills them with the calls at `0019E2C0` + 0x3AE, + 0x3CA (`r8d` copies of `r9`) and + 0x3F9, frees `B` through slot `+0x18` (`0019E2C0` + 0x434) when non-null and stores the new `B`, `E` and `C`

calls the function at `0019EA20` + 0x22 with (`r8`, qword `rcx+8`, `rdx`) and the one at `0019EA20` + 0x31 with (`rcx`, that result, qword `rcx+8`), then lowers qword `rcx+8` by (`r8`-`rdx`)/0x130 (signed) times 0x130 and returns `rdx`

calls the function at `001AAE70` + 0x19 with (`rcx`, qword `[rcx]`, qword `[rcx+8]`); then, when qword `[rcx]` is non-null, calls vtable slot `+0x18` of the object at `rcx+0x18` with (that qword, (qword `[rcx+0x10]` minus it) / 0x30 (signed) times 0x30); returns on both paths

for k from 0 while k is below (qword `[rcx+8]` minus qword `[rcx]`) / 0x30 (recomputed each pass, unsigned 32-bit compare) copies qword `+8` to qword `+0x10` of the 0x30-byte element k when its byte `+0x28` is non-zero; then for each element from `[rcx]` up to `[rcx+8]` whose qword `+8` (`p`) is non-null calls vtable slot `+0x18` of the object at element `+0x20` with (`p`, (qword `+0x18` minus `p`) AND ~7); finally stores qword `[rcx]` into qword `[rcx+8]`

when qword `rcx+8` (`E`) is below qword `rcx+0x10` (unsigned) it advances qword `rcx+8` by 0x30 and, when `E` is non-null, copies dword `[rdx]` and word `rdx+4` to `E`, calls the function at `001AD0C0` + 0x4C with (`E+8`, `rdx+8`) and copies byte `rdx+0x28` to `E+0x28`; otherwise calls the function at `001AD0C0` + 0x60 with (`rcx`, `E`, `rdx`)

returns when `edx` is at most (qword `[rcx+0x10]` minus qword `[rcx]`) / 0x30 (unsigned 32-bit compare); otherwise calls the function at `001B1A20` + 0x4F with (`rcx`, `edx`, qword `[rcx]`, qword `[rcx+8]`) for `P`, frees the old `[rcx]` when it is non-null through vtable slot `+0x18` of the object at `rcx+0x18` (with the old `[rcx]` and the old capacity count times 0x30), and stores `P`, `P` plus the old (qword `[rcx+8]` minus qword `[rcx]`) / 0x30 times 0x30, and `P` + `edx`*0x30 at qwords `[rcx]`, `[rcx+8]` and `[rcx+0x10]`

returns when dword `rcx+0x20` (`d`) is 0x80 or more (signed); otherwise reads qword `P` from the table `01F81880` at index dword `01F81834` * 0x80 + `d` and, when `P` is non-null, calls vtable slot `+0xE0` of qword `01F81840` with `rdx` = `P` and stores 1 at dword `01F81850`[dword `01F81834`] when it is 0; in both cases increments dword `rcx+0x20`

clamps `edx` to 0 when negative and to 0x1FF when above it (signed) for a bit index `b`, then in the 0x288-byte record at `02098E10` + `ecx`*0x288 (`ecx` sign-extended) sets bit `b` AND 31 of dword `+0x244` + (`b` >> 5)*4 when `r8d` is non-zero, else clears it

returns 0 when qword `02EBA508` (`H`) is null, when `ecx` is above byte `H+4` (signed), or when `edx` is not below the word at `H+0x18+10*ecx` (signed); otherwise, with `g` = `edx`/16 (signed) and `O1`, `O2` the dwords at `H+0x10+10*ecx` and `H+0x14+10*ecx` (assembled byte by byte), starts from the 24-bit little-endian value at `H+O1+3*g` shifted right 2 and, for each of the `edx`-16*`g` dwords `w` from `H+O2+64*g`, adds (`w`>>1) AND 0x1FFF when bit 0 of `w` is clear, else ((`w`>>2, taken as 0 when it is 0x3FFFFFFF) + 0x7FF) >> 11; returns dword `02EBA500` plus that sum

with `P` = qword `+0x320` of qword `0209AC30`: when `P` is non-null, `ecx` is 0 and bit `0x2` of dword `P+0x570` is clear, calls the function at `00561280` + 0x29 with `rcx` = `P`, sets that bit and returns; when `P` is non-null, `ecx` is non-zero and the bit is set, calls the one at `00561280` + 0x47 with `rcx` = `P`, clears the bit and returns; in every other case calls the function at `00561280` + 0x61 with (1, 3) and tail-jumps (at `00561280` + 0x72) with (0, 3)
stores the address `00D58098` at qword `[rcx]` and qword 0 at `+0x50` of qword `rcx+8`
stores the address `00D68DF0` at qword `[rcx]`, zeroes qwords `+8`, `+0x18`, `+0x28` and dwords `+0x10`, `+0x20`, `+0x30`, and returns `rcx`
